targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ServiceName) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
SELECT round(max(Value), 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.record_send_rate' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(max(Value), 0) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.connection_count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(max(Value), 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.request_latency_avg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) * 100, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'kafka-1' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) * 100, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'kafka-2' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='kafka-1') * 100, 2) as `kafka-1`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='kafka-2') * 100, 2) as `kafka-2` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='kafka-1') / 1073741824, 3) as `kafka-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='kafka-2') / 1073741824, 3) as `kafka-2` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.outgoing_byte_rate'), 2) as `producer-out`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.incoming_byte_rate'), 2) as `consumer-in` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.outgoing_byte_rate','kafka.consumer.incoming_byte_rate') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.request_latency_avg'), 2) as `latency-avg`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.request_latency_max'), 2) as `latency-max` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.request_latency_avg','kafka.producer.request_latency_max') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.batch_size_avg'), 2) as `batch-avg`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.batch_size_max'), 2) as `batch-max` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.batch_size_avg','kafka.producer.batch_size_max') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round((1 - avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.buffer_available_bytes') / avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.buffer_total_bytes')) * 100, 2) as `buffer-used-%` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.buffer_available_bytes','kafka.producer.buffer_total_bytes') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.fetch_rate'), 2) as `fetch-rate`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.records_consumed_rate'), 2) as `records-rate` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.consumer.fetch_rate','kafka.consumer.records_consumed_rate') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Producer Records per Request & Requests In-Flight

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.records_per_request_avg'), 2) as `records-per-req`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.requests_in_flight'), 2) as `in-flight` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.records_per_request_avg','kafka.producer.requests_in_flight') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'kafka-%' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
